newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Securities says in injection talks.
newsitem.headline: Asia Securities says in injection talks.

text.p: Asia Securities International Ltd said it was in talks with third parties, including China's Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation (MOFTEC), in relation to a possible capital injection.

"The company is still negotiating with third parties which include a company under the administration of the MOFTEC in relation to the proposed injection of capital into the company," Asia Securities said in a statement on Wednesday.

Asia Securities -- which engages in property development, investment holding and securities trading -- said it would make another statement when there were further developments and warned investors to exercise caution in dealing in its shares.
The company's shares, which rose HK$1.125 on Tuesday, were down HK$0.45 at HK$5.00 in mid-morning trade on Wednesday.
